_meta._note: S199 source-audit sweep of config/seed_sources.yaml (627 sources). Result: DB already current vs 8 major live leaderboards (LiveBench/Aider/SWE-rebench/MathArena/ARC-AGI/Epoch-ECI/Vellum/LLM-Stats — 0 net-new frontier models) and 17 of 18 recent arxiv benchmark papers already ingested. The ONE genuine net-new benchmark: AgentGym2 (Fudan NLP, arxiv 2607.05174). AgentGym2 = 437 tasks / 27 domains testing end-to-end agentic execution: tool discovery via exploration, tool composition for unseen tasks, robustness to noisy/underspecified inputs; splits Complex-Tool-Use 182 / Data-Analysis 57 / Deep-Search 198. Metrics Overall Avg@3 (mean over 3 runs) + Pass@3. Scores from the paper's main results table (arxiv HTML v1). NEW models Nex-N1-671B / Nex-N1-32B are the authors'-cited (agiteam2025) open-weight agentic family. Latest-models-focus applied: ingested the 235B+ / flagship rows, skipped the small Qwen3-8B/32B rows.
